value.rationale: The exact endpoint quantitatively separates prefactor-one global L2 contraction from ordinary RKDG qualitative CFL stability in a canonical nonnormal semidiscrete operator. The explicit low-frequency obstruction is structurally informative and testable, and the algebraic constant is a natural benchmark for nonlinear-entropy stabilization and precise time-step selection; it is not a mere restatement of semidiscrete energy decay or generic RK stability. The theorem has clearly bounded applications and does not claim relevance to other entropies or all DG degrees.
